title: Greek Pita Pizza with Chickpea Spread, Bell Peppers, Tomatoes & Olives

steps.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim, seed, and medium dice bell peppers. Place in a medium bowl.
Halve tomatoes lengthwise and add to the bowl with the bell pepper.
Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel, halve, and small dice onion. Peel and mince garlic. Add both to the bowl with the other veggies.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies, basil, and salt; cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to soften, 4-5 minutes. Remove from heat. (Reserve bowl for next step.)
Meanwhile, drain and rinse chickpeas; place in the reserved bowl.
Juice lemon into the bowl with the chickpeas, then add tahini, oil, and spices. Using a fork or potato masher, roughly mash chickpeas until semi-smooth and set aside.
Arrange pitas on a large baking sheet pan; evenly top with chickpea spread, then cheese, veggies, and olives.
Place baking sheet in the oven and bake until pizzas are warmed through and cheese is melted, 6-8 minutes. Remove from oven and cut into wedges.
To serve, divide pizzas between plates. Enjoy!
